tw-ia-tipton-iwers-farm-1936.st: In June 1938 the Iowa Supreme Court upheld Henry Iwers's will in the '$350,000 machine shed treasure' case, leaving the estate to the couple who had cared for him.

tw-mi-smyrna-marshall-bank-loot-1932.st: Gallagher was taken near Smyrna, northeast of Lowell, in June 1932; no recovery of the remaining $3,600 was reported in the 1932-34 papers.
